parameters.content:
**Automated Data Pulls:** Set up a scheduled n8n workflow that automatically extracts 7-day performance metrics from:
**Google Analytics 4:** (Sessions, Users, Page Views)
**Google Search Console** (Clicks, Impressions, CTR)
**Encharge** (Email broadcast metrics)
**Gojiberry** (LinkedIn outreach leads)
**Claude Reasoning Engine:** Built a custom aggregation node that feeds the raw metrics and week-over-week comparisons securely into Claude (Anthropic) to generate a plain-language executive brief.
Safe, Read-Only Delivery: Configured a secure delivery node that formats Claude's insights into a clean HTML email and sends it directly to your inbox. There is zero publishing risk.
Global Error Alerting: Implemented a failsafe Error Trigger (originally slated for Phase 4) that will immediately email you with a direct link to the logs if the automation ever fails to run.
